representativeSamples.label: close

representativeSamples.label: high
representativeSamples.selectionRule: draw whose total is nearest the 95th-percentile total (265), then margin nearest p50 margin; ties → lowest runIndex

representativeSamples.label: low

representativeSamples.label: upset
